version answers with the base version, the resolved impact, what determined
that impact, and the next version. It is read-only.

bump is major, minor or patch, and names the impact instead of inferring
it. Without a bump, the impact is inferred from the commits since the base
version. Without --target, the release line is the branch origin/HEAD
points to. Exits 1, after printing the answer, when no release is
warranted or the version policy refuses the version.

Usage:
  release version [bump] [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for version
      --json            Render the answer as JSON instead of YAML
      --target branch   The release line to compute for: a branch (default: the branch origin/HEAD points to)
